scoreNote: Strong-adequate (4.5): grants that imagination is essential, then argues knowledge is at least as important; two developed examples with analysis, controlled prose on a memorable First and Second skeleton.

sentences.text: Einstein once suggested that imagination matters even more than knowledge.
Some people argue that in most professions and fields, imagination is more important than knowledge.
I agree that imagination is essential, but I believe it is rarely more important than knowledge in most fields.
First, imagination is clearly essential to progress in nearly every field.
It is imagination that lets people picture new ideas, designs, and solutions.
For example, a scientist must first imagine a possibility before she can ever test it.
This shows that without imagination, knowledge alone would simply repeat what is already known.
Artists, inventors, and engineers all depend on the power to imagine what does not yet exist.
Imagination is what turns familiar facts into genuinely new creations.
To this extent, imagination truly is a precious and necessary gift.

sections.role: Body 2 — Why knowledge is equally important

sentences.text: Second, however, imagination is rarely more important than the knowledge that supports it.
Without knowledge, imagined ideas are often impossible, useless, or even dangerous.
Consider an engineer who imagines a beautiful bridge but lacks the knowledge to keep it from collapsing.
Such cases show that imagination without knowledge can fail badly in the real world.
In most professions, deep knowledge is exactly what makes an imagined idea actually work.
Doctors, lawyers, and builders rely above all on knowledge that must be accurate and complete.
Imagination and knowledge, then, are partners, with neither simply more important than the other.
In conclusion, imagination is essential and gives knowledge its purpose and direction.
But in most fields, knowledge is just as important, since it turns imagined ideas into reality.
The best work in any field comes from imagination and knowledge working closely together.
